card.text: The Butterfly Cluster is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 452 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6405: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 451.8697801 pc (16th to 84th percentile 452 to 452)

sources.quote: The Butterfly Cluster is an open cluster of stars in the southern constellation of Scorpius.

introduction.text: The Butterfly Cluster is drawn as 533 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
